description: Traffic between a board's sites for a range: each site's visitors, and hops (from, to, visitors) — visits to a site whose referrer is another site of the same board. External traffic is not included.

board.description: A board's id from list_boards (a UUID), or its exact name

anyOf.description: A custom window of whole UTC days, 1 to 30 days, ending today at the latest

range.description: 24h, 7d or 30d, or a custom window { "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD" } (UTC days, up to 30). Default 7d.

name: get_flow
title: Get traffic between sites
